text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The extended overseas tour began, marking 
the start of authentic training on French 
soil.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expectations for "Project L'Arc" mount 
in Japan, Mei Satake does her utmost all 
around to ensure they leave behind solid 
results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just two months remain until the Prix 
Niel, her first true test— Determined to 
build momentum in her opening battle, 
Japan's representative is fired up and 
ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Venus Park, considered one of 
the top contenders for the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe, also begins preparations for 
the big day ahead—
